pages.text: $(l)Upon entering Chapter 3, complete the first 3 warpers via the wormhole to obtain Deep Blue Matter from the Vanolite Gateway.$()
$(li)Use the Valonite Gateway to access Betweenlands non-EMC blocks—no need to enter the dimension.

$(li)Prioritize acquiring resources for NuclearCraft machines early; turbine recipes should be feasible—if not, optimize your infrastructure.$(li)Passivate at least the Plutonium isotope chain in Chapter 3; most Chapter 3 mining can be skipped until Chapter 4.
